html.body: Date: 2025-03-06 Remarks Applicant elects Invention I with traverse, which the Office identifies as encompassing claims 1-10. To support its restriction requirement, the Office contends that claims 11-20 of Group II "do[] not require the suspension system in the directional pad found in [independent claim 1 of] Group I." Action at 2. The claim language shows otherwise for claims 11-19 of Group II:1. A directional pad for a controller, the directional pad comprising:a shell that includes a top that has opposing upper and lower surfaces;a suspension system that:Group I Claim 1 is coupled to the shell; and includes three or more elastic arms, wherein each of the arms extends between a first end that is coupled to the shell and a second end that is disposed lower than the shell and the first end of the arm; and a haptic actuator that is configured to vibrate the shell.11. A controller comprising ...... a directional pad comprising:a shell that includes a top that has opposing upper and lower surfaces;a suspension system that:is coupled to the shell; and includes three or more elastic arms, Group II Claim 11 wherein each of the arms extends between a first end that is coupled to the shell and a second end that is coupled to the body of the controller and is disposed lower than the shell and the first end of the arm; and a haptic actuator that is configured to vibrate the shell The Office accordingly has not supported its basis for restricting claims 1-10 and claims 11-19. And the Office's grouping of independent claim 20 with claims 11-19 (Action at 2) reflects that there is no serious search and/or examination burden for examining independent claim 20 in addition to a group that includes claims 11-19. Applicant thus respectfully requests withdrawal of the restriction requirement.Applicant does not acquiesce to the Office's characterizations of the claim language, and reserves the right to challenge any such characterizations in the future. The Examiner is invited to contact the undersigned attorney with any questions or comments relating to this application.Respectfully submitted, NORTON ROSE FULBRIGHT US LLP /Michael Pohl/ 98 San Jacinto Blvd., Suite 1100 Austin, TX 78701 Michael Pohl (512) 536-3113 Reg.
